findings.summary: The inverse-sine formula retained English side names in the Turkish trigonometry section.
evidence: The previous expression was θ = sin^-1(opposite / hypotenuse).
findings.resolution: Changed the side names to karşı and hipotenüs.

findings.summary: The inverse-cosine formula retained English side names in the Turkish trigonometry section.
evidence: The previous expression was θ = cos^-1(adjacent / hypotenuse).
findings.resolution: Changed the side names to komşu and hipotenüs.

findings.summary: The inverse-tangent formula retained English side names in the Turkish trigonometry section.
evidence: The previous expression was θ = tan^-1(opposite / adjacent).
findings.resolution: Changed the side names to karşı and komşu.
